description: This file defines enums and related logic for representing and managing icon states, activity types, and role states within an application, likely related to user interface icons and activity indicators.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Returns the string name of the symbol associated with the current icon state based on activity kind.

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Returns the prominence level of the badge, if applicable.

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Indicates whether the icon state is in a working mode.

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an override selection to a corresponding icon state.
